data.name: Naphtiel
data.gender_notes: Naphtiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Naphtali comes from the Hebrew roots naphtal, meaning 'my struggle', and el, meaning 'God'. Therefore, the name Naphtali can be interpreted as 'God's revelation through my struggle'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel and as the name of a son of Jacob.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's presence and guidance during difficult times.
data.etymology: Naphtiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's revelation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naphtiel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: נַפְתָּל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נַפְתָּל הוא שם בהקשר של המקרא, הקשור בארץ ישראל. פירוש השם 'בן-נפתלי' (נַפְתָּל 'גדל' 'גדל' 'גדל' ). לפי המקרא, נַפְתָּל היה בן שִׁבְעָה (שִׁבְעָה ) (בראשית ל', 36), נַפְתָּל (בראשית ל', 38) (בראשית ל', 39). השם נַפְתָּל נמצא בכלל שם ישראל (בראשית ל', 33).

in_greek.name: Ναφθαλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νάφθαλ (Νάφθαλ) είναι όνομα που συνδέεται με την Παλαιστίνη. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'υιος-Ναφθαλ' (υιος-Ναφθαλ 'παιδί του Ναφθαλ' ). Στον Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Νάφθαλ (Νάφθαλ) ήταν γιος του Ιαΐρ (Ιαΐρ) (Λουκάς 3:26).

in_latin.name: Naphtali
in_latin.long_meaning: Naphtali est nomen quod connectivum est cum terra Israel. Nomen significat 'filius-Naphtali' (filius-Naphtali 'filium Naphtali' ). Secundum Bibliam, Naphtali erat filius Iair (Iair) (Lucas 3:26).

in_english.name: Naphtiel
in_english.meaning: son of Naphtali, meaning 'branch of God' in Christian context
in_english.long_meaning: Naphtiel is a Christian name with roots from Hebrew, meaning 'son of Naphtali', which symbolizes 'branch of God'. In the Bible, Naphtali was a son of Jacob (Genesis 30:8). The name is associated with the tribe of Naphtali, one of the twelve tribes of Israel. In Christian tradition, Naphtiel is considered a strong and spiritual name, representing growth and development. It is also associated with the qualities of faith, hope, and charity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naphtali has deep roots in Jewish and Christian traditions, as it is mentioned in both the Hebrew Bible (Old Testament) and the New Testament. In Jewish tradition, Naphtali is one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and its members were believed to have a strong warrior spirit. In Christian tradition, Naphtali is mentioned as the name of a son of Jacob and the brother of Joseph, who was a prominent figure in the early Christian story of the Joseph auction and sale into Egypt.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Naphtali carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the importance of facing our struggles and difficulties with faith in God. The name suggests that even in our struggles, we can find divine revelation and guidance if we surrender ourselves to God. Naphtali's name is a reminder that God is with us in our toughest battles and that He can bring good out of even the most challenging circumstances. Therefore, the name Naphtali is an inspiring name for those who seek to follow God through their struggles and challenges in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Naphtali: God's wrestling, or God's struggle. Reflecting the biblical story of Jacob's night-long struggle with the angel, symbolizing the spiritual journey of overcoming personal challenges with divine guidance.

biblical_reference.note: Naphtali is mentioned as one of the sons of Jacob in the book of Genesis.

historical_references.reference: Naphtali is the name of a son of Jacob and Bilhah, mentioned in the Old Testament Book of Genesis (30:8).
historical_references.context: The Hebrew Bible, also known as the Old Testament, is a collection of religious texts or scriptures sacred to Christianity, Judaism and Samaritanism.

historical_references.reference: Naphtali is also a name given to one of the twelve tribes of Israel, in the Old Testament Book of Numbers (1:14).
historical_references.context: The Hebrew Bible describes the twelve tribes of Israel as the descendants of the twelve sons of Jacob. Each tribe was named after one of these sons.

It is particularly popular among individuals seeking biblical or unusual names for their children. Naphtiel can be found on various baby names websites as a suggested name for parents with this preference. In Jewish communities, the name Naphtiel is used as a given name and is also found in the context of Jewish heritage and history. Additionally, naming consultants may recommend Naphtiel to clients who are looking for a name with historical or cultural significance.
